title: Motion design software that creates animations instantly #motiondesign #animation
description:
Claude Code introduces Remotion, a tool that transforms the motion design process by allowing users to create promo videos, animations, and graphics through simple text commands rather than traditional timeline editing. By integrating Remotion directly within Claude Code, users can generate complete motion designs without needing expertise in keyframes or complex software.

The platform’s core insight is enabling motion design through natural language input, which dramatically lowers the barrier for creating professional animations. This innovation works by instantly updating all elements—colors, timing, text, and animations—in response to chat-based adjustments, making the creative process intuitive and efficient.

This approach offers significant value to both businesses and individual creators by reducing time, effort, and the need for specialized skills in producing quality motion graphics, thus expanding access to high-quality visual content.
